title: Code and data for deep reinforcement learning of proactive mosquito control for chikungunya prevention
description: Python code, trained PPO policies, environment parameters and evaluation outputs that reproduce every number, table and figure in the manuscript 'Proactive mosquito control for chikungunya prevention: a deep reinforcement learning policy trained on a weather-driven simulator and evaluated on a held-out year' (prepared for PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases). The Gymnasium environment wraps a literature-parameterized mechanistic simulator of the weekly Breteau index driven by ERA5 weather for ten Guangzhou grids (2015-2022).
